settlement webhook 502s. 14% of deliveries failing over the last fifteen minutes. opening an incident.
i am on it. taking IC.
merchant visible?
yes. failed deliveries retry for 6h so no data loss yet, but merchants see gaps in their dashboards right now.
502s are coming from the ingress, not the app. app pods are healthy, no restarts. looking at the gateway.
my dual-key verify deploy went out at 08:41, timing is suspicious. happy to roll it back.
timing fits but the errors are pre-app. hold, do not roll back yet.
found it. the verifier reads the raw body, so the gateway buffers the request, and batch settlement payloads exceed the 256kb body buffer limit. the gateway 502s before the app ever sees it.
of course it is a buffer limit. it is always a buffer limit.
raising the gateway body limit to 2mb and streaming the body in the verifier instead of buffering it. john's change stays. NW-116.
deployed. error rate 14% to 0.03% in four minutes. retry queue draining, 11k deliveries pending.
retry queue is empty. no data loss. incident resolved. writeup will be in NW-115.
nice work. ninety minutes start to finish, and you did not roll back the wrong thing.
for the record i was fully prepared to take the blame and it would have been wrong
